description: Trafiksäkerhetsklass-Korsning is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by trafikverket.se. The data product consists of Traffic Safety Class-Crossing phenomena belonging to the product group STVDB and the product subgroup Administrative phenomena in STVDB. Describes intersections where the road network has been classified from a road safety perspective. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Road safety class-Crossing" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
